TOPA_and_captain_basis.literature_mechanism: Clause vivification / asymmetric literal elimination by unit propagation; RUP clauses are independently checkable by propagating the negation to conflict.
TOPA_and_captain_basis.theta_transfer: A literal is removed only when the omitted part is certified decision-irrelevant by a polynomial check; there is no heuristic rank cutoff.
TOPA_and_captain_basis.why_selected: The R35 core is connected, has no articulation points, has zero complete affine-bundle coverage, no 2-CNF clauses, and a non-authoritative min-fill width of 16 on 23 variables. A discovery probe on the exposed core found many one-literal RUP strengthening opportunities, while failed-literal probing alone found no forced literal.

single_new_mechanism.input: The exact frozen R35 residual only, reconstructed from the byte-frozen seed/generator/R33 stack and checked against the frozen core hash.
single_new_mechanism.rule: For canonical clause C and one literal l in frozen literal order, let D=C\{l}. D is admissible exactly when deterministic unit propagation on current F conjoined with the negations of every literal in D reaches conflict. Replace C by D, canonicalize duplicate clauses, and restart the scan from the first clause.
single_new_mechanism.rule_semantics: The RUP check proves F entails D. Since D subsumes C, adding D and deleting C preserves logical equivalence, hence SAT/UNSAT and all models.
single_new_mechanism.terminal_unsat: After every successful strengthening and at fixpoint, deterministic unit propagation on the whole current formula may certify contradiction. Only such a checked conflict licenses UNSAT.
single_new_mechanism.stall: If no one-literal RUP strengthening exists and whole-formula unit propagation does not conflict, return STALLED_RUP_CORE with no SAT/UNSAT verdict.
single_new_mechanism.tie_break: Canonical clause tuple order, then literal key (absolute variable, positive before negative).
single_new_mechanism.strict_progress: Every successful rule deletes at least one literal and never adds a literal. Therefore the number of successful strengthenings is at most the initial literal-occurrence count.

per_strengthening: deterministic unit-propagation conflict witness / replay receipt
certificate_contract.independent_checker: Replay the exact sequence from the frozen R35 core. For every proposed D, independently run unit propagation on the current formula with all literals of D assigned false and require conflict before applying the replacement.
certificate_contract.final_UNSAT_checker: Independently run unit propagation on the final formula and require conflict.

complexity_contract.unit_propagation_per_check: polynomial in current CNF size; implementation must expose a deterministic operation ledger rather than call a SAT solver
complexity_contract.overall_claim: R35B may claim only that this fixed rule is polynomially executable/checkable. It may not close the R31 universal-progress obligation because a future formula may have zero RUP strengthenings.
complexity_contract.memory: No truth table, DPLL state, or assignment cube may be stored.

frozen_controls.expected: Exact measure [98,300,23] and SHA-256 7c42618d0fbb3b6e2d6681e265e56a76fa80b4021fd2ad1590d6f5fe9fb608ff before candidate execution.

frozen_controls.purpose: Small independently enumerable control in which a RUP strengthening and checker can be cross-validated after candidate terminal.
Control where the mechanism must not invent an unsupported one-literal strengthening.

interpretation_firewall.success_on_exposed_core: Closes only the sealed R35 counterexample for the extended fixed portfolio. The core was used to discover this rule, so a fresh unseen non-affine holdout is mandatory before any generalization evidence.
interpretation_firewall.stall: Falsifies completeness of the fixed R35B mechanism on this core only; preserve the residual before proposing another rule.
interpretation_firewall.next_if_UNSAT_success: Freeze the implementation byte-for-byte and run R36_FRESH_NONAFFINE_RUP_VIVIFICATION_HOLDOUT on newly generated seeds selected after freeze, without tuning.
